en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, raising it, said,

‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> was asked about a man who gave wealth to a man to perform Hajj on his behalf, but he performed Hajj for himself. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘It would be (Reckoned as being) on behalf of the owner of the wealth’.
en.sarwar: 2. Muhammad ibn Yahya in a marfu‘ manner has narrated the following: “

Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, was once asked about a man who receives a certain amount to perform al-Hajj for another person, but he performs al-Hajj for himself. He (the Imam) said, ‘It is for the owner of the asset.’”
